skill.name: expense-sync
skill.description: Sync Wise transactions into the expense ledger with historical pattern matching and specific merchant overrides.
skill.sync_intent:
0. If `expense-ledger-schema` is not already in the prompt or tool history, call `read_skill("expense-ledger-schema")` in the same turn as step 1 (do not wait for a separate turn). 1. Parallel: `get_categories()` + `fetch_wise_transactions(since, until)` + `get_historical_patterns()` 2. `exec_sql` multi-row INSERT:
INSERT INTO public.expense (name, amount, category, paid_date, paid) VALUES (...), (...) ON CONFLICT (name, amount, paid_date) DO NOTHING;
- Round amounts up to integer - `paid_date` = Wise `createdOn` (`YYYY-MM-DD`); `paid = true` for completed outward - Map each row using `` from `expense-ledger-schema` - For uncategorized transactions: - If merchant name contains 'cursor' or 'hetzner', set category to 'Software'. - If merchant name contains 'google' or 'openai', set category to 'Tokens'. - Otherwise, apply category from `get_historical_patterns()` based on merchant name. 3. Report insert count + range only after INSERT returns.
- Do not syncronize withdrawal transactions
